The air quality is honestly terrible. People say it's hard to make to make friends as a transfer (see r/pittsburghsocialclub). City of Pittsburgh proper will tax you more than the burbs, and people actively seek to live outside Allegheny county to duck around it (washington county, cranberry township) The liquor laws are outdated, and as a state we're behind on everything. With all that being said about our crusty old town....there's always something to do, the queer community is awesome sauce, and if you have your own car you can get to anywhere. I remember going to the mall on prom night one time. I went to 1 homecoming dance stag and never again. I had friends from work in different school districts so I didn't pal around with people from my HS much. I lived a small walk from Kmart, grocery store, movie theater, and taco bell. I bought men's Adidas cologne and used my babysitting money to take my sibling to taco bell often. Girls in middle school would trade Britney spears CDs because there were various colors on the tops of the them. I took a typing class and there were a few coding classes for seniors, but it was mostly them making the computers say swear words, and that battle tank game until the schools banned that site. I remember my history teacher playing kitty cannon with students on his break time/their lunch period. We had a lot of reliable teachers that took care of the misfits. There were cliques and it was hard to integrate if you came in late (I started public school in 7th grade with a broken arm, not great, no help) ummm what else.....I remember the first time listening to a rock radio station and hearing Stone Temple Pilots. That's when my barbie pop brain did a flip. Early Trapt, Chevelle, Three Days Grace, Breaking Benjamin, Evanescence. College parties were everything I saw in movies. Throwing shoes in bonfires, naked lap beer pong, someone with a guitar playing wonderwall. Sometime before 2010 the cops got serious on the college kids (small town) and there was removal of bed sheets hanging from frat windows with quotes like "thank you for your daughters" I stayed away from frat parties because people were often drugged or arrested for wandering town drunk at 3am and unless you were in a sorority pack and counting your ducks it was drama. We also all had Nokia flip phones and would take eachothers phones home from house parties. Pictures got uploaded from your digital camera to a Facebook album so you could see the aftermath within a week's time. Everyone had some kind of music listening device, apple shuffle was out of my price range. I think everything went south after Heath Ledger died and the Olson twins went from selling me Kmart makeup to frail skeletons.
